tools.name: list_symbols
tools.description:
List the instruments SPECTRE Markets publishes a levels board for, with the session each
        board is for and a link to the full board.

tools.name: get_levels
tools.description:
Today's free levels for one instrument (e.g. "NQ", "ES"): the market regime, the named
        free levels with their prices, a short excerpt of the desk read, and how many further levels
        the full board holds. Research/education only.

tools.name: get_paths
tools.description:
Today's ranked possible session paths for one instrument, each with its waypoints and a
        trade idea (entry zone, invalidation, target). Research/education only.
